title: Tenacious Boots
summary: Inaccessible Medium Armour boots give +1 Athletics and can prevent forced movement.

fields.Athletics: +1 to Athletics checks. Requires Medium Armour proficiency.
fields.Stand Like Stone: Bonus Action once per Short Rest. Spend 1 turn of Force Conduit to gain Force Steadfast for 1 turn and prevent unwilling movement.
fields.Base value: 90 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
